washington.name: North riverbank bicycle link
washington.length_rule: Straight endpoint distance times 1.10, allowing a hypothetical approach allowance.
washington.access: Hypothetical unrestricted bicycle and cargo-cycle access, no toll, no capacity constraint.
washington.assumption: Map-anchored abstract connection only. No terrain, grade, land ownership, navigation clearance, structural feasibility, environmental or regulatory validation.
washington.baseline: corrected existing network, all crossings open; each link installed separately
